steps.note: Water about equal to the dahi in volume is added in stages, warm or cold to keep the churning temperature.
The dahi is churned with a wooden or motor-driven beater.
The fat floats up in lumps and is lifted off, leaving the buttermilk (chhach or lassi).

links.name: Makkhan (Indian cultured butter): a review, J Food Sci Technol (2020)

sources.text: The household churning of dahi with water added, the temperatures, and the buttermilk (chhach, lassi) left when the fat is gathered, from this review.
